# lago_subscription (Resource)

Manages a Lago subscription.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    lago = {
      source  = "registry.opentofu.org/rpcpool/lago"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "lago" {
  api_endpoint = var.lago_api_endpoint
  api_key      = var.lago_api_key
}

resource "lago_customer" "acme" {
  external_id = "acme-corp-001"
  name        = "Acme Corp"
  email       = "billing@acme.example.com"
}

resource "lago_subscription" "acme_pro" {
  external_id          = "acme-corp-001-pro"
  external_customer_id = lago_customer.acme.external_id
  plan_code            = "pro_plan"
  name                 = "Acme Pro Subscription"
  billing_time         = "anniversary"

  on_termination_credit_note = "credit"
  on_termination_invoice     = "generate"
}

variable "lago_api_endpoint" {
  type = string
}

variable "lago_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `external_customer_id` (String) External identifier of the customer to subscribe. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `external_id` (String) Unique external identifier for the subscription. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `plan_code` (String) Code of the plan to subscribe the customer to. Can be changed in-place to trigger a plan upgrade or downgrade.

### Optional

- `billing_time` (String) Billing time anchor. Allowed values: `anniversary`, `calendar`.
- `ending_at` (String) End date and time for the subscription (RFC3339). When set, the subscription will be automatically terminated at this date.
- `name` (String) Display name for the subscription.
- `on_termination_credit_note` (String) Credit note behaviour on termination. Allowed values: `credit`, `refund`, `offset`, `skip`.
- `on_termination_invoice` (String) Invoice behaviour on termination. Allowed values: `generate`, `skip`.
- `subscription_at` (String) Start date and time for the subscription (RFC3339). Defaults to the current date when not set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Subscription creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Terraform resource ID, set to the subscription external ID.
- `lago_id` (String) Lago internal UUID for the subscription.
- `started_at` (String) Subscription start timestamp (RFC3339).
- `status` (String) Current status of the subscription (`active`, `pending`, `terminated`, `canceled`).
